id: # TV / audio source registry (ADR-0014). `device` is the SOURCE and is the only field that does anything:
#   yt:<page>      a YouTube watch/live page — yt-dlp resolves the CURRENT media URL each capture (live CDN
#                  URLs expire, so the page is what is stored, never the resolved URL). Needs yt-dlp.
#   url:<stream>   a direct stream URL (HLS/DASH/Icecast) — ffmpeg reads it straight
#   pulse:<name>   a host audio input (records what THIS machine plays)
# Edit via the muni UI (TV / Audio) or by hand; the live copy is local/audio-sources.csv, never the template.
# Default: Bloomberg's own verified Bloomberg Television YouTube live stream. Recording is for PRIVATE
# analysis only (transcript-as-lead, never redistributed) and remains subject to Bloomberg's and YouTube's
# terms — replace the source if that is not the basis you want.
